name: sql-data-api
displayName: SQL Data API (App Service + Azure SQL)
description: A .NET API on App Service backed by Azure SQL Database, using passwordless managed-identity auth and Entra-only SQL administration. Dev runs serverless SQL; prod runs zone-redundant compute and database.
what: A .NET API on App Service backed by Azure SQL Database. The app authenticates to SQL passwordlessly via its managed identity, and the SQL server uses Microsoft Entra-only authentication. Dev uses serverless auto-pause SQL; prod uses zone-redundant compute and database.
why: Most business apps are a stateless API in front of a relational database. Doing it passwordlessly (managed identity + Entra-only SQL) removes the most common security failure - leaked connection strings - while the dev/prod split keeps lab costs low and production resilient.
potentialUseCases: A CRUD/business API over relational data (orders, customers, inventory)
Modernizing a legacy app's data tier to managed Azure SQL
Demonstrating passwordless, Entra-only database access patterns
A reporting or back-office API that needs transactional consistency

reliability: Zone-redundant App Service plan and zone-redundant SQL database in prod
Azure SQL automated backups with point-in-time restore
Health checks evict unhealthy app instances
security: Microsoft Entra-only authentication on the SQL server (no SQL logins)
Passwordless app-to-SQL connection via managed identity
HTTPS-only, TLS 1.2 minimum on both tiers
costOptimization: Provisioned vCore in prod sized to steady load
Scale app capacity to demand; consider reservations for prod
operationalExcellence: Telemetry in Application Insights + Log Analytics
Entra admin managed as a group object id
performanceEfficiency: Premium v3 app compute in prod
Connection pooling via managed identity tokens

components.name: Azure SQL Database (GP Gen5 2 vCore)
components.notes: 2 vCores x 730 hours, General Purpose provisioned. Priced per vCore-hour.
